data.name: 漢字でGOGO!
data.detailed_description:
【About Answer Judgement】

This game judges handwritten answers based on the overall shape and components of the character written by the player.
As a result, even if a character is technically incorrect, it may still be judged as correct if its parts or overall form are similar enough.

If someone created a universal model capable of correctly recognizing almost every writer’s unique or heavily distorted handwriting while rejecting almost every missing stroke, malformed character, and visually similar alternative, it would—only half-jokingly—be a landmark achievement in computer science, perhaps even putting the Turing Award within sight.

This game uses existing handwriting recognition technology together with game-specific judgment adjustments. However, perfect judgment across every possible handwriting style cannot be guaranteed.

Please keep this recognition behavior in mind before purchasing the game.

【If a Specific Character Is Not Recognized Properly】

If you contact us through the inquiry form and include an image of the character you actually wrote, we will consider judgement adjustments depending on the details.

For more details about the judgement specifications, please also see the “Character Forms / Recognition” section of the KanzideGOGO! FAQ.

【About the Steam Overlay】

Due to technical limitations related to NW.js, the runtime environment used by this game, the Steam Overlay is not available. As a result, the overlay cannot be opened with Shift+Tab while playing. Thank you for your understanding.

――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――

KanzideGOGO! is a kanji quiz game where you write kanji and compound words by hand.

Using the katakana reading and clue shown on the screen, write the correct kanji answer by hand. Whether you want to play casually or challenge yourself with difficult words, you can test your kanji skills in the mode that suits you best.

Main Modes

Entertainment

A relatively approachable mode recommended for streamers and first-time players. Start here to enjoy fast-paced kanji quizzes.

Serious

Unlocked by meeting certain conditions. This is a high-difficulty mode featuring challenging words that are not commonly seen in everyday life.

Rush

A mode where you can keep taking on questions of the same level. Perfect when you want to focus on practicing a specific difficulty.

Useful Features

Customize

Change game settings such as lives and time limits. You can make the game easier to play, or challenge yourself under stricter conditions.

Jukebox

Change the background music on the mode selection screen. Set the mood before starting the game with your favorite track.

Question Checker

View the questions included in the game. Questions from Serious Mode require you to have reached the corresponding level.

Bonus Mode

KAKITORI ISSEN

A score attack mode where you write the given kanji quickly and carefully. Speed matters, but so does the way you write each character.

From familiar kanji to obscure words that may make you doubt your own eyes, see how far your kanji skills can take you.

data.short_description: A kanji quiz game where you write kanji and compound words by hand. Test your kanji skills across multiple modes, from the accessible Entertainment Mode, to the challenging Serious Mode, the same-level Rush Mode, and the bonus score attack mode KAKITORI ISSEN.

pc_requirements.minimum:
최소:
  • 운영 체제: Windows 10 64-bit
  • 프로세서: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD FX-6300 相当以上
  • 메모리: 4 GB RAM
  • 그래픽: DirectX 11 対応グラフィック
  • DirectX: 버전 11
  • 저장 공간: 2 GB 사용 가능 공간
  • 추가 사항: マウス操作対応。手書き入力にはマウス、ペンタブレット、またはタッチ対応環境を推奨します。

data.legal_notice:
©Gotcha Gotcha Games Inc. / YOJI OJIMA 2020
Character recognition powered by machine learning from CaptainDario (DaAppLab)
For JIS Level 3 and later kanji, Micelle created handwritten samples and registered game-side alias mappings based on the averaged recognition candidates returned by the model.
These mappings are applied within the game and do not modify the original recognition model.

Kanji stroke data is derived from KanjiVG r20260714 by Ulrich Apel
and is licensed under Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 3.0 Unported.

For use in this game, the ordered stroke data was sampled, normalized,
quantized, and converted into recognition-index.json.
The derived recognition index remains licensed under CC BY-SA 3.0.
